findings.reason: An SSH private key signs into servers and Git hosts as you. The s1ngularity payload grabbed id_rsa directly.
findings.fix: Keep this key out of the interview account. Passphrase-protect it, or use a hardware or agent-backed key.

findings.reason: Your SSH config lists the hosts and key files you connect to, a map for an attacker.
findings.fix: No action needed, but note it reveals your other keys and hosts.

findings.reason: This file holds long-lived AWS access keys. Shai-Hulud read ~/.aws/credentials to pivot into cloud accounts.
findings.fix: Prefer short-lived SSO sessions; keep this file out of the interview account.

findings.reason: The AWS config names your profiles, regions and SSO start URLs.
findings.fix: Lower risk than credentials, but still account structure an attacker can use.

findings.reason: This JSON is a usable Google Cloud credential. Shai-Hulud collected application_default_credentials.json.
findings.fix: Run 'gcloud auth application-default revoke' when not in use; keep it out of the interview account.

findings.reason: The Azure CLI stores your subscriptions and signed-in identity here; its token cache sits beside it.
findings.fix: Sign out of unused subscriptions; keep the .azure folder out of the interview account.

findings.reason: A registry auth token in .npmrc lets code publish packages as you. Shai-Hulud and s1ngularity both read ~/.npmrc.
findings.fix: Use a short-lived or granular token; set ignore-scripts; keep .npmrc out of the interview account.

findings.reason: The GitHub CLI stores your OAuth token in hosts.yml, full access to your repos.
findings.fix: Do not sign the GitHub CLI in inside the interview account; if a task needs GitHub, use a short-lived fine-grained token there.

findings.reason: Your .gitconfig can embed credential-helper tokens or URLs with secrets. s1ngularity collected .gitconfig.
findings.fix: Check for inline tokens; prefer an OS credential manager.

findings.reason: id.json is an unencrypted Solana private key. Lazarus npm packages extracted ~/.config/solana/id.json.
findings.fix: Do not keep funded keypairs on a dev box; move this out of the interview account.

findings.reason: Exodus stores its wallet here; the same campaigns target exodus.wallet.
findings.fix: Keep crypto wallets off the machine where you run stranger code.

findings.reason: Electrum keeps wallet files here; s1ngularity's wallet hunt listed Electrum.
findings.fix: Encrypt wallets and keep them off this machine.

findings.reason: s1ngularity enumerated AI CLI config and tokens (Claude, Gemini, Q). A stored session token here acts as you.
findings.fix: Do not sign your AI CLIs in inside the interview account; finish-setup turns their startup hooks off there.

findings.reason: s1ngularity targeted the Gemini CLI's config alongside Claude and Q.
findings.fix: Do not sign the Gemini CLI in inside the interview account.

findings.reason: PSReadLine saves every command across sessions. Secrets typed on a command line linger here (MITRE T1552.003).
findings.fix: Clear it, and avoid passing secrets as command-line arguments.

findings.reason: Opening any folder can run its .vscode/tasks.json without asking: Workspace Trust is disabled, automatic tasks are set to run.
findings.fix: Turn Workspace Trust on and set task.allowAutomaticTasks to off.

findings.reason: Local State holds the key that decrypts the saved-password DB.
findings.fix: Keep browsers signed out in the interview account; do not sync profiles there.

findings.reason: Chromium stores site logins in Login Data (MITRE T1555.003). Stranger code can copy the DB and the key.
findings.fix: Keep browsers signed out in the interview account; do not sync profiles there.

findings.reason: Web Data holds autofill entries and saved payment cards.
findings.fix: Keep browsers signed out in the interview account; do not sync profiles there.

findings.reason: MetaMask's browser-extension storage is present. BeaverTail enumerates these wallet extension IDs.
findings.fix: Do not install wallet extensions in the account where you run stranger code.

findings.reason: Phantom's browser-extension storage is present. BeaverTail enumerates these wallet extension IDs.
findings.fix: Do not install wallet extensions in the account where you run stranger code.

findings.reason: A .env usually holds API keys and connection strings. InvisibleFerret collects .env files across all drives, skipping node_modules.
findings.fix: Keep project .env files out of the interview account, or load secrets from a vault.
